key_findings: ADSC-CM reduced endometriotic lesion area, ICAM-1 and VEGF expression in mice, and improved pregnancy outcomes; adding ADSCs blocked the inhibition.
Proteomics/IPA flagged PTX3 as a candidate mediator.
